tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Search WIPE Around's map of Israel's local businesses (beauty and wellness, health, trades, food, shops, classes…). Write what is wanted in plain Hebrew: the town, the trade, a budget and a time are read from the words, e.g. "קוסמטיקאית ברעננה", "חשמלאי בחולון", "טיפול פנים בחיפה עד 400 השבוע". In E

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Everything WIPE Around shows about one business, as Markdown: trade, town, address, phone, WhatsApp, website, hours, booking, services with prices, and more. Pass its slug or its around.iw.pe/b/… address (from search_businesses).
